title: The Fallen Kingdom
author: Unknown
description: A weathered tome recounting the fall of a forgotten realm.
pages:
{"text":"In ages past, a great kingdom
stood where only ruins remain.

Its people were wise, its walls
were strong, yet it fell all
the same."}

{"text":"Some say a creeping darkness
consumed it from within.
Others speak of betrayal
by those closest to the throne.

The truth, as always, lies
somewhere in between."}
